instruction: I frequently visit websites with different character encodings. Could you set Chrome's default text encoding to UTF-8 to ensure proper display of international characters?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default text encoding to UTF-8. The evaluator checks if the default_encoding in Chrome preferences matches 'UTF-8' (case-insensitive). UTF-8 is the universal character encoding that supports all languages and special characters.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Chrome's default text encoding from the Preferences file (intl.charset_default field)
Metric performs appropriate case-insensitive comparison for encoding names
Expected value 'UTF-8' is semantically correct for the instruction requirement
Postconfig properly restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction
Proper error handling with fallback to default value (ISO-8859-1) if reading fails
Platform-specific paths are correctly implemented for Windows, macOS, and Linux (including ARM)
